title: Thailand Cambodia Vietnam All Together | FREE Excursion to Coral Island
highlights: Explore three countries, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam in 16 days, visiting 20+ iconic sites, including UNESCO World Heritage sites and vibrant local markets.
Cruise through Halong Bay’s emerald waters, home to around 1,600 limestone islands and islets, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Visit Angkor Wat, the world's largest religious monument, showcasing Cambodia’s ancient Khmer architecture.
Dive into thrilling water activities at Coral Island near Pattaya, surrounded by clear turquoise waters.
overview:
About the Tour:
This 16-day tour covers major highlights in Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam. Explore Bangkok's vibrant streets, visit Cambodia’s iconic Angkor Wat, and cruise through Vietnam’s Halong Bay. Experience bustling markets, historical temples, and scenic landscapes in cities like Siem Reap, Phnom Penh, Hanoi, and Ho Chi Minh City. The itinerary includes cultural experiences, boat rides, and guided sightseeing, offering a blend of history, nature, and local flavors across three countries.

know_before_you_go: Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change during peak season and blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you’ll get transferred to the hotel for check in. Spend the rest of the day exploring the place at your leisure. You can visit places such as the Temple Of Literature, known for well-preserved traditional Vietnamese architecture. Also, explore Hoan Kiem Lake, where you can stroll around the shore, and relax. After exploring the place, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Today, board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel for an exciting Ninh Binh city tour. Begin with a visit to Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam, where you can explore the historic temples of the Dinh and Le Dynasties. Afterwards, embark on a boat ride from Hoa Lu to Tam Coc, gliding through stunning limestone rock formations and vast rice fields, and marvel at the caves formed over millions of years. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise Experience
days.desc: Begin your day by checking out of your hotel and setting off on a scenic drive to Halong Bay, taking in the countryside views of Northern Vietnam en route. Upon arrival at Tuan Chau Harbour, board a cruise and prepare to be captivated by the amazing views of various islets as you sail through the bay. Later, visit Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village by boat, where you can enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. Afterwards, return to the cruise for an overnight stay on board.

items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax. 
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food. 
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Your day begins on the cruise with a Tai Chi lesson, a traditional martial art. Next, explore the Surprise Caves, the largest in Halong Bay, where you'll be amazed by the intricate rock formations hanging from the ceilings. Afterwards, disembark and transfer to Hanoi. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and enjoy some leisure time. Post that, you can visit places like the historic Temple of Literature or the artisan hub of Bat Trang Ceramic Village on your own before returning to the hotel.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Enjoy your journey by joining the Tai Chi lesson on the cruise. Explore the other parts and islands of the Halong Bay. 
Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest caves in the Halong Bay and admire it's scenic beauty. 
Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay

days.title: Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels | Ho Chi Minh City Tour
days.desc: Get ready for Ho Chi Minh City tour, starting with a visit to the historic Independence Palace, a symbol of Vietnam’s reunification. Next, marvel at the French colonial architecture of Notre Dame Cathedral and Central Post Office. Head to the War Remnants Museum to explore exhibits showcasing the history of the Vietnam War. Following this, visit the famous Cu Chi Tunnels, an intricate underground network used during the Vietnam war. In the evening, get a transfer to the hotel for a night stay.

days.desc: Start your day with a transfer to My Tho city and visit the beautiful Vinh Trang Pagoda, a renowned Buddhist site with impressive architecture. Continue your journey with a stop at An Khanh, where you can explore the lush surroundings and enjoy local activities. After some time at leisure, return to Ho Chi Minh City for an overnight stay at your hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Angkor Wat
days.desc: Enjoy an exciting day as you explore Angkor Wat on a sightseeing tour. Get driven from your hotel to the Bayon Temple, where you'll learn about the region's royal culture and history by visiting the Royal Enclosure and Leper King Terrace. Continue the tour with visits to the temples of Thommanon, Chaosay Tevoda, and Ta Keo. Conclude your day by exploring Angkor Wat and witnessing the Hindu mythology stories etched into its walls. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel for a restful overnight stay.

days.title: Bangkok City Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to go on Bangkok city tour, as you board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel. During the tour, visit the Grand Palace, home to Thailand's kings with stunning architecture. Explore Wat Phra Kaew, the Temple of the Emerald Buddha, known as Thailand’s most sacred temple. Then, head to the Wat Benchamabophit, the Marble Temple, known for its exquisite Italian marble. Experience the vibrant floating market and the bustling streets of Chinatown, before returning back to the hotel.

days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Pattaya. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can witness Pattaya’s vibrant nightlife, including its renowned street markets and nightclubs. Visit the lively Walking Street for a mix of entertainment and dining options. Explore the city's beachside attractions like Pattaya Beach or enjoy local shopping. After a fun-filled day, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

Afterwards, return to Pattaya Pier by a speedboat and get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Phi Phi Island
days.desc: Today, get ready for a tour of the Phi Phi Islands. Board your transfer to Phuket Pier and take a speedboat to the islands. Visit Maya Bay, known for its stunning turquoise waters and as the filming location for ‘The Beach’. Explore Loh Samah Bay’s crystal-clear waters and Monkey Beach, famous for its playful monkeys. Witness the beauty of Koh Phi Phi Leh, before returning to Phuket Pier by speedboat and further, getting transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
